title: Months Added to a Cushion Reship for Earlier Wrong-Item or Lost-Package Reships (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
**Rule.** Months are added to a no-charge reship of the fitting cushion item in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program for a patient Summit Ridge has already let down. They are added to the months the reship covers before the monthly rate is applied:

- **two months** when the enrollment shows two or more no-charge reships for wrong item or carrier lost in the last 12 months before this one;
- **one month** when it shows exactly one;
- otherwise none.

## Counting the earlier reships

Count the enrollment's no-charge replacement lines whose reason is wrong item or carrier lost and whose ship date is fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the handling day. Replacements for a mask-fit exchange or a manufacturer defect are not counted.

| Earlier wrong-item or carrier-lost reships in the last 12 months | Months added |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 |
| 1 | 1 |
| 0 | 0 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- One carrier-lost reship 4 months ago and one wrong-item reship 9 months ago: two reships, two months added.
- One wrong-item reship 7 months ago and one manufacturer-defect replacement 2 months ago: one counted reship, one month added.
- One carrier-lost reship 13 months ago: outside the 12 months, nothing added.
